verdict.line: You lose if you walk into Shock Blast-Gate pokes at range without a plan; you win because Kled's 61.5% win rate over 91 games says this lane rewards aggression the moment Jayce is forced into melee.

brief.thesis: Jayce wants to stay in Cannon Stance and poke with Q (Shock Blast) through his E (Acceleration Gate) while kiting; Kled wants to close the gap and force Hammer Stance trades where Jayce's threat drops. Every short-trade you win on Skaarl's health bar pushes this lane toward the 61.5% side of the matchup, not the 49.7% baseline.

theirWindow.when: Jayce in Cannon Stance at range
theirWindow.what: He can fire Q (Shock Blast) for poke damage to all enemies hit, and if he drops E (Acceleration Gate) first the missile gets faster, longer range, and more damage. Do not walk straight down the gate line — approach at an angle or through brush so the empowered Shock Blast doesn't connect clean.

yourWindow.when: Jayce swaps to Hammer Stance or his Q/E are both on cooldown (8-16s Q, 12-20s E)
yourWindow.what: Hammer Stance Jayce has no ranged poke left — his Q (To the Skies!) is a melee leap and his E (Thundering Blow) is a 240-range knockback. This is when you dash in with E (Jousting) and commit the full trade; his tools here can't out-damage your W (Violent Tendencies) attack speed window.

start.why: Chosen in 54.2% of games (60% win rate over 65 games) because the extra sustain and AD let you force short trades inside Jayce's melee range without losing the all-in math.

boots.why: Picked in 88.7% of games (62.8% win rate over 94 games) since the attack-reduction mitigates the repeated auto-pokes and knockback setups Jayce chains together.

core.why: Opens the 80%-win-rate (over 5 games) path into a burst window that punishes Jayce the instant you land E (Jousting) on him.
Core item in both top-performing paths; the bonus health and wave-clear let you threaten all-in without giving up lane presence.
Appears in every listed core path; the armor shred compounds with Kled's dash-reset trades to close out fights before Jayce resets range.

runes.keystoneWhy: Run in the 50%-popularity (30% pick) page because Kled's trade pattern is extended skirmishing, not a single burst window, and Conqueror's stacking adaptive damage rewards staying on Jayce through his melee-range openings.

summoners.why: The most-picked combo (67.8% pick rate, 55% win rate) — Ignite punishes Jayce's low early sustain once you force a trade, and Flash covers the gap-close onto a kiting ranged laner.

playing.title: Track his stance before engaging
playing.detail: Hammer Stance Jayce (To the Skies! leap, Thundering Blow knockback) has no ranged poke. Only commit your E (Jousting) dash when he's stuck in Hammer or both his Q and E are down.

playing.title: Approach off the gate's line
playing.detail: If Jayce drops his Cannon-Stance E (Acceleration Gate) and lines up a Q (Shock Blast) through it, the missile gets extra speed, range, and damage. Walk at an angle through brush rather than straight down his sightline.

playing.title: Save W for the full trade
playing.detail: W (Violent Tendencies) gives four empowered attacks with the fourth hitting hardest — pop it the instant you land E (Jousting) so Jayce can't disengage before the big fourth hit lands.

playing.title: Use Pocket Pistol after dismount
playing.detail: Once Skaarl's health bar empties and you dismount, your Q becomes Pocket Pistol — a ranged knockback blast that also restores courage. Use it to peel Jayce off you while you rebuild toward remounting.

playing.title: Save R for the 3500-range engage
playing.detail: Chaaaaaaaarge!!! (140/125/110/110/110s cooldown) covers 3500 range and auto-locks the first enemy champion hit — use it to catch Jayce before he can kite to his tower or allies.

playing.title: Respect the early poke window
playing.detail: From level 1-2 his Cannon Q outranges your 800-range Q, so don't walk forward to trade — wait for minion aggro or his cooldowns before stepping up.

playing.title: Punish his E cooldown
playing.detail: Thundering Blow (Hammer E) is on a 12-20s cooldown — once he uses it to peel you off, that's your window to re-engage immediately since he has no way to create distance again.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, runes, summoners, and win rates above are measured from live games on the current patch (16.20.1) via OP.GG; the mechanical reasoning and trade-timing advice are my own analysis layered on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Be careful of Jayce’s ranged Shock Blast (Q) – Acceleration Gate (E) combo pokes as well as his To the Skies! (Q).
